stories.title: Im alter von 34 Jahren: „Breaking Bad“-Schauspieler RJ Mitte gestorben

en.title: At age 34: "Breaking Bad" actor RJ Mitte dies
en.summary: RJ Mitte, who gained international recognition playing Walter White Jr. in Breaking Bad, has died at 34. Like his character, he lived with cerebral palsy.

stories.title: Fall Block, Ermittler beschlagnahmen Aufnahmen: Volle Solidarität mit der »Zeit«

en.title: Block case, investigators seize recordings: Full solidarity with 'Zeit'
en.summary: A Hamburg court has ordered the weekly newspaper Zeit to hand over recordings related to the Block case. Authorities describe the court's decision to compel the publication to surrender these materials as potentially dangerous.

stories.title: Wechseljahre verändern Körper laut neuer Studie früher als gedacht

en.title: Menopause changes body earlier than previously thought, new study shows
en.summary: A new study indicates that menopause begins much earlier than commonly believed and brings significant bodily changes. Symptoms include hot flashes, sleep disturbances, and weight gain.

stories.title: "Breaking Bad"-Schauspieler RJ Mitte mit 34 Jahren gestorben

en.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies at 34
en.summary: RJ Mitte, an actor and disability rights activist known for his role in the series Breaking Bad, has died at age 34. He incorporated his personal experiences with his condition into his acting work.

stories.title: Ermittlungen im Fall Block: Die Hausdurchsuchung bei der „Zeit“ ist ein eklatanter Bruch der Pressefreiheit

en.title: Investigations in Block case: House search at 'Die Zeit' is a blatant breach of press freedom
en.summary: Prosecutors and police conducted a house search at the weekly newspaper Die Zeit in connection with the Block case. The incident raises concerns about implications for society if such conduct becomes routine.

en.title: Israel denies work visa to taz correspondent
en.summary: Israeli authorities have refused to grant a work visa to journalist Serena Bilanceri, accusing her of making boycott calls. The correspondent has previously faced entry difficulties into the country.

stories.title: Friedrich Merz kritisiert: »Radikale Töchter« klagt gegen Bund wegen Förderstopp

en.title: Friedrich Merz criticized: "Radical Daughters" sues federal government over funding halt
en.summary: The democracy project "Radical Daughters" accused Chancellor Merz of racism and subsequently lost its previously secure funding. The case has now reached court, with emails potentially linking the two events.

en.summary: Tech billionaire Elon Musk is reportedly the largest individual donor ahead of congressional elections where Trump's party faces pressure.

en.title: Qatar Airways, Etihad Airways: Several airlines cancel flights to Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Multiple Gulf state airlines will not fly to Saudi Arabia in the coming days following an attack on Riyadh airport by Houthi militants.

stories.title: USA: Elon Musk soll 276 Millionen Dollar für die Republikaner gespendet haben

en.title: USA: Elon Musk reportedly donated 276 million dollars for the Republicans
en.summary: According to reports, Elon Musk has donated substantially to Republicans ahead of congressional elections, despite individual donation limits being strictly regulated.

en.summary: Following leadership changes in the SPD including a new Labor Minister, the Union is pushing for rapid progress on pension reform while SPD leadership reorganizes.

en.summary: At an employers' conference, Chancellor Merz pushes for rapid social reforms and sets expectations for the new minister and pension reform objectives.

en.summary: The Vonovia CEO discusses left-wing plans to expropriate housing companies in Berlin and reveals the company's future investment intentions in the capital.

stories.title: Warenhäuser: 75 Millionen Euro Insolvenzgeld für Großteil der Galeria-Mitarbeiter bewilligt

en.title: Department Stores: 75 Million Euros in Insolvency Benefits Approved for Majority of Galeria Employees
en.summary: Galeria has received approval for 75 million euros in insolvency compensation for most of its employees, allowing the department store chain to continue operations. The decision does not apply to all workers.
